newsitem.title: USA: Municipal Mortgage files for $250 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Municipal Mortgage files for $250 mln shelf.

text.p: Municipal Mortgage and Equity LLC said Monday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $250 million in growth share limited liability company interests.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including new investments, working capital and repayment of indebtedness, the filing said.
The Baltimore, Md.,-based company is a self-advised and self-managed limited liability company which invests primarily in tax-exempt instruments, including tax-exempt mortgage revenue bonds.
